title: Supervised Fine-Tuning to Reinforcement Learning: Train Models to Think Better
description:
**Note:** It is mandatory to both RSVP and fill out this Google Form https://forms.gle/pJamac2Ejq3LYkZY6 if you miss either of these, the security will not allow you to attend the event. Please ensure that you do not miss filling it out.

This is an in-person meeting only.

**Note:** Certificates will be provided for those who attend the event and fill out the Google Form that will be shared at the end of the event.

**About the event**

How do you train a model to get better at a task? What examples do you give it? How do you decide which answers deserve a reward? And once you’ve trained it, how do you know it actually improved?
We’ll work through these questions together, starting with a pretrained model and using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with LoRA to train it on examples. Then we’ll explore DPO for learning from preferences and GRPO for reinforcement learning with rewards. Along the way, we’ll look at what changes inside the model, where things get tricky and what you need to try this yourself.

This is a hands-on session, so we’ll spend time with code, compare results and make sense of the numbers. We’ll also tackle a question that’s easy to overlook when training seems to be going well and that is, is the model getting better at the task or just getting better at earning the reward?

If you’re curious about how models learn after pre-training, come along. Some familiarity with Python and machine learning will help, but you don’t need to have trained a model before.

Looking forward to seeing you at the venue and happy learning.

title: Generative AI: From Fundamentals to AWS
organizer: AWS User Group India AI ML
description:
Generative AI is rapidly changing how we build applications, work with data, and develop software. But what exactly is Generative AI, how do Foundation Models and LLMs work, and how do these concepts translate into real-world solutions on AWS?
In this session, we’ll start with the **fundamentals of Generative AI** and progressively connect those concepts to practical AWS services through hands-on demonstrations.

### What we'll cover

**1\. Generative AI Fundamentals**

* AI vs. Generative AI
* What makes Generative AI different
* What GenAI can create — text, images, code, audio, and video

**2\. Foundation Models & LLMs**

* What Foundation Models are
* How they differ from traditional task-specific models
* Understanding Large Language Models (LLMs)
* How a single model can perform multiple tasks
* Real-world Generative AI applications

**3\. Working with Generative AI**

* Prompt Engineering
* Few-Shot Prompting
* Understanding and handling hallucinations
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* AI Agents and tool/API integration

### Live Demos

**Amazon Bedrock**
Explore Foundation Models, generate content, and see how **RAG and Knowledge Bases** connect models with external and enterprise data.
**PartyRock**
Build a Generative AI application without writing code, understand what happens behind the application, and see how user inputs can generate personalised results.
**Amazon Q Developer**
See how Generative AI can become part of the software development workflow — from generating and explaining code to debugging, fixing, and refactoring it.

### Bringing It All Together

We’ll close by looking at where Generative AI fits within the AWS ecosystem, including:

* **Amazon Bedrock** — building applications with Foundation Models
* **PartyRock** — experimenting and building GenAI applications without coding
* **Amazon Q Developer** — AI-assisted software development
* **Knowledge Bases** — connecting GenAI applications to enterprise knowledge using RAG
* **Agents for Amazon Bedrock** — connecting AI models to tools, APIs, and business workflows

Whether you're **new to Generative AI or already experimenting with LLMs**, this session is designed to give you a clear understanding of the concepts while showing how they can be applied using AWS.
Come learn the fundamentals, see the technology in action, and understand how to move **from Generative AI concepts to practical AWS solutions.**

* Why Agentic SDLC requires an engineering approach, not just agent orchestration.
* The AgenticStack framework and how it structures AI across every SDLC phase.
* A live demonstration of an end-to-end Agentic SDLC workflow.

**More about the event**

Building an Agentic SDLC is far more than connecting a few AI agents together. Modern software delivery is a complex ecosystem of specialized roles—including Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps, Infrastructure, UAT, Release Management, and Support—each with well-defined processes, inputs, outputs, and quality gates.

Simply introducing AI agents does not transform software delivery.
The real opportunity lies in engineering each SDLC phase with purpose, enabling specialized AI agents to augment individual roles before orchestrating them into a connected, governed, and measurable delivery lifecycle.
At Lead With Tech, we call this AgenticStack—an engineering-first approach to building Agentic SDLC. Instead of focusing on isolated AI agents, we focus on designing intelligent workflows, role-specific agents, governance, and seamless collaboration across the entire software delivery lifecycle.

title: Handling Real Time data in Fabric Eventhouse
description:
**Event Details:**

* **Date:** 19 September
* **Time:** 10:00 AM IST
* **Speaker:** Naveen Nagar \| [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/naveen-nagar-01108730/)

**About the Event:** In today's data-driven world, organizations increasingly need to make sense of high-volume, fast-moving data - sensor telemetry, clickstreams, transactions, and logs - before the opportunity to act on it passes. Join us for this technical meetup as we explore Fabric Eventhouse, Microsoft Fabric's purpose-built engine for real-time analytics. This session will move beyond traditional batch pipelines to demonstrate a modern, low-latency data architecture where streaming data is captured, indexed, and made queryable within seconds. We will walk through a complete real-time data flow - from a live streaming source, into Eventhouse, and out to every consuming engine in Fabric via OneLake - without data duplication or performance trade-offs.
**What we will cover:**

* **Architecture:** An end-to-end walkthrough of a real-time pipeline built on Fabric Eventstream, Eventhouse, and OneLake.
* **Eventstream & Ingestion:** How Eventstream captures, transforms, and routes streaming events from sources such as Azure Event Hub, IoT Hub, and CDC connectors into Eventhouse.
* **Eventhouse & KQL Database:** How KQL databases automatically index and time-partition data on arrival, and how update policies and materialized views enrich and aggregate data as it lands.
* **OneLake Availability:** How a single copy of streaming data becomes instantly available to Power BI, Warehouses, Notebooks, and Lakehouses through OneLake, eliminating the need for separate ETL copies.
* **Live Demo:** A practical, live walkthrough showing data flow from a streaming source, through Eventstream, into Eventhouse, out to OneLake, and into a live Power BI report in near real-time.

**This session is designed for:**

* Data Engineers & Architects working with streaming data
* Power BI Developers & Fabric Users
* Analytics teams building real-time or near-real-time dashboards

title: Build an Agentic Invoice Verification Process with UiPath Maestro Flow
description:
**WHAT IS THIS VIRTUAL WORKSHOP IS ABOUT?**
UiPath Maestro Flow lets you orchestrate multiple automations, AI agents, and human decision points as one connected process — with full visibility into where a case is at any moment. Instead of just automating a task, you're orchestrating an entire business outcome. This session is your chance to build that kind of process yourself, step by step.

* Working in UiPath Maestro Flow, you'll design and configure a live process that:
* Triggers automatically when an invoice email arrives
* Extracts and transforms the invoice data
* Queries Purchase Order records to validate the invoice against the matching PO
* Branches based on whether the vendor name matches — routing to the right next step automatically
* Hands off to an AI agent to investigate discrepancies, or to a second AI agent to research an unfamiliar vendor name
* Inserts a human review checkpoint for cases that need a judgment call
* Auto-drafts a response and sends it back to the vendor/requester — closing the loop without manual effort

You'll configure each stage yourself in UiPath Maestro Flow, connect the agents and human task into the flow, and test it against real sample scenarios (matching vendor, mismatched vendor, valid alias, invalid vendor).

By the end of the session, you'll have built a working, end-to-end agentic process in UiPath Maestro Flow that autonomously verifies invoices against purchase orders, brings in AI agents for judgment-heavy steps, escalates to a human only when needed, and auto-responds — all orchestrated and trackable.
You'll also leave with a reusable pattern you can apply to any similar exception-handling process in your own environment.

title: How to build an agent-ready IDP with open source tools
description:

title: Connect and Analyze Multi-Channels all in one platform
description:
Greetings Everyone,

Every organization runs on data - but that data rarely lives in one place.
Sales are stored in your database. Customer interactions live in your CRM. Marketing performance is spread across advertising platforms. Website behavior sits inside analytics tools. Finance, support, inventory, and operations each maintain their own systems.
Individually, these tools answer **what** happened.

The real challenge is understanding **why** it happened.
Questions such as:

* Why did revenue decline despite higher website traffic?
* Which marketing campaigns are bringing in customers who actually stay and spend?
* Why are conversions dropping for one customer segment but improving for another?
* Which operational bottlenecks are impacting customer satisfaction?
* Where are we losing revenue without realizing it?

Finding these answers usually means jumping between dashboards, exporting spreadsheets, writing SQL queries, and manually piecing together information from multiple systems - a process that can take hours or even days.

In this live webinar, we'll explore how modern AI is changing that.

Using real-world business scenarios, you'll see how AI can connect information across databases, analytics platforms, CRMs, advertising systems, ERPs, and other business tools to investigate complex questions that no single dashboard can answer on its own.

Rather than simply generating charts, AI can reason across multiple sources, identify hidden relationships, trace the chain of events behind business outcomes, and provide evidence-backed explanations.

**What You'll See:**

* How AI connects securely to multiple business data sources while preserving business context
* A live investigation into a real business problem using data from several systems simultaneously
* How AI identifies patterns and relationships that are difficult to uncover through traditional reporting
* How business context improves the accuracy and relevance of AI-generated insights
* A live demonstration where business questions are asked in plain English and investigated across multiple data sources in real time

**Who Should Attend:**

* Business leaders looking for faster, better decision-making
* Marketing and growth teams trying to understand what truly drives revenue
* Product, operations, and analytics teams working with data across multiple platforms
* Data analysts and engineers interested in the next evolution of analytics
* Anyone curious about how AI is transforming business intelligence and decision-making

**What you will Learn:**
You'll discover how modern AI can work across the systems where your business data already exists - including databases, CRMs, analytics platforms, advertising tools, ERPs, and operational systems - to create a unified understanding of your organization.

Instead of analyzing each platform independently, AI can investigate questions across multiple sources simultaneously, helping teams move beyond isolated metrics toward understanding cause and effect.

By the end of the session, you'll have a practical understanding of how organizations are using AI to reduce manual analysis, uncover hidden insights, investigate business problems more effectively, and make faster, more informed decisions.
